title: Chain federal learning method based on grouping and weight self-optimization

pse.problem: Heterogeneity in federated learning leads to performance degradation and slow convergence speed.
pse.solution_function: Chain federated learning method based on grouping and weight self-optimization optimizes the global model by utilizing client computing power, improving convergence speed and accuracy.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of servers and clients divided into n groups, each containing m clients. Relevant parameters include the initial global model, initial weight distribution model, and initial weights of each client's local model.
pse.solution_implementation: 1. Server divides all clients into n groups. 2. Server initializes relevant parameters and saves the test set. 3. Starting from the first group of clients, the server updates the global model and weight distribution model based on the local models of clients in each group.
pse.effect: Improved convergence speed and accuracy in federated learning due to efficient utilization of client and server computing power.
